summary: A national connectivity strategy [launched with US$1.5bn of planned investment to 2030](2025-07-18-techafricanews-tchad-connexion-2030-strategy-1-5b), with no implementation report, expenditure statement or monitoring framework published.
developments:
The strategy was developed with lender support and external analysis; its horizon is rendered as 2030 in one account and as within six years in another ([strategy](2025-07-18-techafricanews-tchad-connexion-2030-strategy-1-5b), [framework](2025-12-10 Chad Finalizes Digital Law to Align National Framework With Global Standards), [registry](2026-03-16 Chad uses national biometric registry to boost govt systems interoperability)).

Nothing is published against it: no implementation report, expenditure statement or monitoring framework at any date. Its named components — a third mobile operator, the fibre backbone, the data centre — are each recorded separately and none has a delivery figure.

An economic and social council adopted recommendations on the digital transition in August 2026; it is an advisory body, nothing binds government to act, and no response is on record ([recommendations](2026-08-19-digitalbusiness-africa-tchad-cesce-recommandations-numerique)).

summary: One article of the [2014 electronic communications and postal law](2014-03-21-tchad-loi-013-pr-2014-regulation-communications-electroniques) was amended by ordinance, ratified by the Senate in December 2025 after the National Assembly in October.
developments:
The ordinance was signed in August 2025, approved by the National Assembly on 22 October by 105 to 31 with 2 abstentions, and ratified by the Senate on 23 December by 65 of 67 ([ratification](2025-10-22-toumaiwebmedias-ratification-ordonnance-011-pr-2025-communications-electroniques), [framework](2025-12-26-afriqueitnews-parlement-cadre-juridique-communications)).

The 2014 law is held only as a degraded scan with a proxied date, the two accounts number the instruments differently, and the amendment's subject is described as licence award conditions while the held article sits under sanctions ([law](2014-03-21-tchad-loi-013-pr-2014-regulation-communications-electroniques)).

So a sector statute was amended by a route the base can date and on a subject it cannot confirm.

summary: A [national data governance strategy](2026-05-13-uneca-giz-chad-national-data-governance-strategy-mission) support mission was convened with the ministry in May 2026, and no draft, timetable or adoption date is published.
developments:
What is held is the mission page and the ministry's terms of reference ([mission](2026-05-13-uneca-giz-chad-national-data-governance-strategy-mission)).

No draft strategy, timetable or adoption date exists on the record. It would sit above a country with no data-protection law, no supervisory authority and a biometric register already interconnected with the finance ministry and a mobile operator.

progress: Mixed, a biometric-data law adopted by 138 votes to 1 while no general data-protection statute or authority exists at all
summary: No [general data-protection law or supervisory authority](2026-03-16-ecofin-ansice-cybersecurity-agency-reform) exists, the function having been folded into the security agency, while a [law on biometric data in judicial procedures](2026-04-11-tchad-loi-donnees-biometriques-judiciaires) was adopted by 138 votes to 1.
developments:
There is no enacted text, number or gazette reference for a general data-protection law, and the function was folded into the security agency in March 2026 ([vacuum](2026-03-16-ecofin-ansice-cybersecurity-agency-reform), [finalisation](2025-12-10 Chad Finalizes Digital Law to Align National Framework With Global Standards)).

The biometric-data law was adopted at a plenary in April 2026. Its gazetted text is not held, so retention periods, destruction procedure, oversight body and any requirement of judicial authorisation are unknown, and deputies raised concerns in debate about inappropriate use ([law](2026-04-11-tchad-loi-donnees-biometriques-judiciaires)).

Legislating the collection of biometric data for judicial use before legislating data protection at all is the sequence, and it is the reverse of the order every other unit in this frame attempts.

summary: A [digital code](2026-04-29-techafricanews-comite-cadre-juridique-numerique) has no adopted text: a forty-five-day drafting deadline set in April 2026 expired in June with nothing on record.
developments:
The code was described as finalised in December 2025 and a committee was then given forty-five days from 27 April 2026 to draft the framework; that deadline expired about 11 June with no text on record ([code](2026-04-29-techafricanews-comite-cadre-juridique-numerique), [finalisation](2025-12-10 Chad Finalizes Digital Law to Align National Framework With Global Standards), [agency](2026-03-16-ecofin-ansice-cybersecurity-agency-reform)).

The committee itself was inaugurated with thirty-four members and mandated to build on prior regulator contributions, and no output is on record ([committee](2026-04-29-techafricanews-comite-cadre-juridique-numerique)).

A ministry system prohibition and an interoperability programme are both recorded separately as depending on a framework that does not exist.

summary: An [ordinance reformed the security and electronic certification agency](2026-03-16-ecofin-ansice-cybersecurity-agency-reform), placing data protection and artificial-intelligence governance inside it, and there is no separate data-protection authority.
developments:
The Senate ratified after National Assembly approval ([ordinance](2026-03-16-ecofin-ansice-cybersecurity-agency-reform)).

The gazetted text is not held. The base records a vote count and an ordinance number that appear in no held source, which is stated here rather than repeated as fact.

Data protection and artificial-intelligence governance sitting inside a security agency, with no independent authority and no statute to enforce, is the governance arrangement this unit has. It is the frame for the biometric register, the subscriber-data interconnection and the police equipment transfer recorded below.

summary: A [regional financial inclusion strategy for 2025-2029](2025-02-01-beac-strategie-regionale-inclusion-financiere-cemac) adopted by the central bank covers the member states; nothing in the window moved it.
developments:
A Chadian delegation drew on the Togolese experience of deploying digital solutions in the agricultural sector ([visit](2026-09-01-togoofficiel-fsrp-agri-numerique-tchad-visite)). The account is the host government's, and nothing states what Chad will adopt.

The central bank adopted a regional financial inclusion strategy for 2025-2029 covering the six member states, validated by the monetary union's ministerial committee on 21 December 2023 and published in February 2025 ([strategy](2025-02-01-beac-strategie-regionale-inclusion-financiere-cemac)); the base holds no member-state implementation plan, target or outturn under it.

summary: The [continental cyber and data protection convention](2026-02-02-au-malabo-convention-status-list) was signed in June 2015 with no ratification and no deposit as at February 2026.
developments:
The depositary's status list of 2 February 2026 records signature only ([status](2026-02-02-au-malabo-convention-status-list)).

Eleven years signed and unratified, in a country with no domestic data-protection statute either, means neither the regional nor the national instrument binds anything here.

summary: The regulator ran the [fifteenth cycle of its service-quality audit](2026-02-13 Chad Plans 50 Telecom Sites, 50 km of Fiber in N'Djamena) and inaugurated [strategic regulatory platforms](2026-06-19-techafricanews-arcep-plateformes-regulation-strategiques) described as a shift to continuous data-driven regulation.
developments:
The fifteenth audit cycle ran September to October 2025 with findings reported in February 2026; the audit reports themselves are not held, and the regulator's own entity page states no penalty it imposed is established, against a held source recording a 2023 fine ([audit](2026-02-13 Chad Plans 50 Telecom Sites, 50 km of Fiber in N'Djamena), [upgrades](2026-06-26-connectingafrica-telcos-network-upgrades-airtel-moov), [fibre](2025-09-02-afriqueitnews-operateurs-connecter-fibre-nationale)).

The platforms were inaugurated by the minister in June 2026, described by the regulator as a shift from compliance-based to continuous data-driven regulation; no cost, supplier, data-retention rule, legal basis or output is on record ([platforms](2026-06-19-techafricanews-arcep-plateformes-regulation-strategiques)).

Fifteen audit cycles with no established penalty, and a new data-driven regulatory apparatus with no legal basis stated, are the two halves of regulation here.

summary: A province was [cut off from the internet for more than three months](2025-02-12-coupure-internet-lac-internet-society) with no restoration on record, and the media regulator [suspended examination of applications to create online newspapers](2026-08-04-hama-suspend-demandes-creation-journaux-en-ligne-tchad) until further notice.
developments:
The province had been cut off since October 2024 and remained so at an internet society communique of February 2025; security reasons were cited but the base holds no official instrument, and restoration may have occurred unrecorded ([shutdown](2025-02-12-coupure-internet-lac-internet-society)).

The regulator suspended examination of online newspaper applications with no end date; the communique carries no date of its own ([suspension](2026-08-04-hama-suspend-demandes-creation-journaux-en-ligne-tchad)).

The suspension is justified by a three-year strategic plan whose text is not held and which is known only through the communique that invokes it, one of its axes being to clean up the profession ([plan](2026-08-04-hama-suspend-demandes-creation-journaux-en-ligne-tchad)).

summary: The whole expenditure chain was [mandated through an integrated public financial management system](2026-01-24-budget-2026-zero-cash-zero-papier-fen) from the 2026 budget, with generalisation pending.
developments:
The mandate runs from the 2026 budget and no coverage figure, count of entities live or implementing agency is named ([mandate](2026-01-24-budget-2026-zero-cash-zero-papier-fen), [orientations](2026-08-04-tchad-budget-2027-numerique-finances-publiques)).

It is the instrument on which the zero-cash and electronic-invoice commitments recorded separately depend, and the only measure of it is that generalisation is pending.

summary: [Talks on a digital infrastructure partnership](2026-03-09-techafricanews-ethio-telecom-chad-mwc-barcelona) were held with a regional incumbent operator at an international trade show, and nothing later is held.
developments:
The talks took place in March 2026 ([talks](2026-03-09-techafricanews-ethio-telecom-chad-mwc-barcelona)).

Nothing later is held. It is one of six international engagements in this unit — with the United States, India, China, Azerbaijan, a regional operator and a continental bank — of which only the Chinese and continental-bank arrangements have produced signed instruments.

summary: A [digital transformation project](2024-09-04 PAD - Chad Digital Transformation Project (PAD00070)) is disbursing and delivered 3,000 payment terminals, a [business-climate and administration modernisation grant](2026-08-20-tchadinfos-bad-chine-accords-financement-modernisation) was signed in August 2026, and Chinese [concessional lending](2020-05-08-ciomag-tchad-pret-eximbank-chine-tic) funds the state connectivity programme.
developments:
The digital transformation project's envelope is carried as FCFA 76.45bn in one source and US$92.2m in another — the first close to total project cost and the second to the grant alone, with no source saying so — and the board approval date differs between the portal and the appraisal document ([project](2024-09-04 PAD - Chad Digital Transformation Project (PAD00070)), [portal](2024-09-25-wb-tcd-001-chad-digital-transformation-project), [concept](2023-02-27 PID Concept Stage - Chad Digital Transformation (P180000))).

The modernisation grant's first phase was signed in August 2026; the pipeline record and the signed grant do not use the same unit or total, so the local-currency figures are the reporting outlet's own conversion ([grant](2026-08-20-tchadinfos-bad-chine-accords-financement-modernisation), [pipeline](2026-07-09-iati-46002-p-td-k00-019-chad-public-administration-modernization)).

The Chinese concessional loan was approved by the National Assembly in 2020, the agreement itself is not held, and a variant figure traces to an unidentified document ([loan](2020-05-08-ciomag-tchad-pret-eximbank-chine-tic), [facility](2019-01-01-eximbank-cn-tcd-001-china-eximbank-provides-rmb-1316-billion)), alongside a grant issued in 2019 at year precision ([grant 2019](2019-01-01-china-mofcom-tcd-001-chinese-government-provides-rmb-170-million)). A microfinance facility reached a fourteenth disbursement ([microfinance](2021-12-18-iati-46002-p-td-i00-012-chad-microfinance-digital-finance-pdmfifj)).

summary: The larger operator's [network investment programme](2026-06-26-connectingafrica-telcos-network-upgrades-airtel-moov) has contested delivery, and [fifty telecom sites and fifty kilometres of fibre](2026-02-13 Chad Plans 50 Telecom Sites, 50 km of Fiber in N'Djamena) were announced by an outgoing minister.
developments:
The investment figure is reported at group level rather than for the national entity, and no source reconciles it with the figures the minister cited ([programme](2026-06-26-connectingafrica-telcos-network-upgrades-airtel-moov), [sites](2026-02-13 Chad Plans 50 Telecom Sites, 50 km of Fiber in N'Djamena), [operator](2025-09-29-digitalbusiness-starlink-fai-vers-operateur-telecom)).

The fifty sites and fifty kilometres were announced at a ministry ceremony by the outgoing minister seven weeks before the portfolio changed hands, and nothing is recorded against them since ([announcement](2026-02-13 Chad Plans 50 Telecom Sites, 50 km of Fiber in N'Djamena)).

A third private mobile operator is named in the national strategy with no licensing process on record ([third operator](2025-07-18-techafricanews-tchad-connexion-2030-strategy-1-5b)).

summary: A [seven-day ultimatum to the two mobile operators](2026-06-26-connectingafrica-telcos-network-upgrades-airtel-moov) to connect to the national backbone was not complied with and no sanction was applied, and the [trans-Saharan section](2026-02-13 Chad Plans 50 Telecom Sites, 50 km of Fiber in N'Djamena) is 60 per cent complete.
developments:
The ultimatum followed a ministerial meeting; the state cited 1,275 km of fibre deployed, a figure no source reconciles with the project's own 1,200 km target, and no sanction was ever recorded as applied ([ultimatum](2026-06-26-connectingafrica-telcos-network-upgrades-airtel-moov), [order](2025-09-02-afriqueitnews-operateurs-connecter-fibre-nationale), [link](2026-02-09-chad-fast-track-ndjamena-mbere-fiber-link-cameroon-connectingafrica)).

The state connectivity programme's first phase was inaugurated at Sarh in January 2026; its 2020 specification of 2,000 km of fibre and 200 masts across twelve regions has never been restated and no delivery is reported against any figure ([programme](2025-12-21-fibre-optique-moyen-chari-pmice-sarh), [phase](2026-01-06 Chad invests 175m in national data center and networks)).

The trans-Saharan section was reported 60 per cent complete on EUR 29m of European financing, with no completion date, operator or route detail on file ([section](2026-02-13 Chad Plans 50 Telecom Sites, 50 km of Fiber in N'Djamena), [delays](2025-03-07-trans-saharan-fiber-project-delays)). A twenty-year border-to-border concession has made no progress ([concession](2026-02-16 Waking the dead - Slow road to extinction for Africa's former telco incumbents 11)).

summary: The [fibre corridor memorandum to a neighbour](2026-02-09-chad-fast-track-ndjamena-mbere-fiber-link-cameroon-connectingafrica) was suspended pending revision, and that route is the country's only entry point for international submarine-cable capacity.
developments:
The ministry ordered the two operators to correct the clauses and sign; the date of the suspension is not established in any source held ([corridor](2026-02-09-chad-fast-track-ndjamena-mbere-fiber-link-cameroon-connectingafrica), [analysis](2026-02-16 Waking the dead - Slow road to extinction for Africa's former telco incumbents 11), [sites](2026-02-13 Chad Plans 50 Telecom Sites, 50 km of Fiber in N'Djamena)).

For a landlocked country this route is the only entry point for international submarine-cable capacity on the record. Suspending the instrument that would build it is the single most consequential regression in this unit.

summary: The [national internet exchange point](2026-05-21-digitalbusiness-tchadix-ixp-un-an) held its first-year general assembly and adopted statutes and internal rules.
developments:
The assembly was held in May 2026, institutionalising the exchange ([exchange](2026-05-21-digitalbusiness-tchadix-ixp-un-an)).

Its stated purpose is to stop traffic leaving the country and returning, and the cost and latency benefit is asserted and never quantified. No member count, traffic volume or peering figure is published.

summary: A [satellite operating licence](2025-03-13-chad-starlink-licence-portail) was granted and commercial launch announced, under an [order on conditions of use](2025-08-28-tchadinfos-arrete-conditions-utilisation-starlink) that mandates identification and retention ahead of any data-protection law.
developments:
The licence was granted in March 2025 and commercial launch was announced by the minister in June 2026; no subscriber count is held at any date, and the government complained to the operator in Washington in May 2026 about service quality and tariffs it judged less competitive than in other African markets ([licence](2025-03-13-chad-starlink-licence-portail), [launch](2025-03-19-starlink-license-chad-launch-niger), [service](2025-07-05-tchadinfos-starlink-services-disponibles), [complaint](2026-06-01-digitalbusiness-washington-partenariats-tech)).

The order on conditions of use was signed in August 2025. Its own number and text are not held, and identification and retention are mandated ahead of any data-protection law ([order](2025-08-28-tchadinfos-arrete-conditions-utilisation-starlink)).

Requiring subscriber identification and data retention in a country with no protection statute and no supervisory authority is the pattern this unit repeats.

summary: The [national data centre](2026-02-06 Chad Moves to Secure National Data Center Ahead of Launch) is built and awaiting audit and certification, an eighteen-month slip on a January 2025 statement that inauguration was forthcoming.
developments:
Building and operational equipment are confirmed complete with audit and certification the last step before inauguration; the facility is four storeys at the capital, measured at about 500 square metres per level and about 2,000 in total by two accounts ([centre](2026-02-06 Chad Moves to Secure National Data Center Ahead of Launch), [audit](2026-02-06 ADETIC, ANSICE, and TECHSO-GROUP Join Forces to Protect Chad's Digital Infrastructure), [finalisation](2025-01-10-agenceecofin-tchad-centre-donnees-national-finalisation), [sovereignty](2025-01-08-data-center-national-souverainete-numerique)).

One hundred government micro data centres are provided for as a clause of the audit agreement rather than as a project with its own instrument ([micro centres](2026-02-06 ADETIC, ANSICE, and TECHSO-GROUP Join Forces to Protect Chad's Digital Infrastructure)).

A facility complete but uninaugurated for eighteen months, with a hundred more announced inside an audit contract, is the shape of this unit's hosting programme.

summary: The minister [rejected fuel-supply excuses and instructed migration of transmission sites to solar or wind](2026-06-26-connectingafrica-telcos-network-upgrades-airtel-moov), and [solar mini-grids for five towns](2026-01-08-mini-reseaux-solaires-cinq-villes) were contracted for delivery by July 2026.
developments:
The instruction was given in June 2026, after the regulator's fifteenth audit had already identified unstable power supply as a recurring fault ([instruction](2026-06-26-connectingafrica-telcos-network-upgrades-airtel-moov)).

The mini-grids were inspected in manufacture in January 2026 with delivery contracted for July 2026 at the latest; that date has passed with nothing on file either way, and power is the constraint the operators cite for network quality ([mini-grids](2026-01-08-mini-reseaux-solaires-cinq-villes)).

Power is the stated cause of the quality failures the audit programme keeps finding and the excuse the minister rejected, and neither instrument aimed at it has a delivery record.

summary: [Information technology equipment was transferred to the national police](2026-07-29-chad-adetic-equips-national-police-cybercrime-tech) for cybercrime work, with nothing stated about training, data retention or legal basis.
developments:
The handover took place in July 2026 ([transfer](2026-07-29-chad-adetic-equips-national-police-cybercrime-tech)).

Nothing is stated about training, camera or hotline data retention, or the legal basis for the surveillance capability. Equipping a police force for cybercrime in a country with no data-protection statute, no supervisory authority and the protection function folded into a security agency is the recurring arrangement here stated in its sharpest form.

summary: A [national cybersecurity strategy](2026-03-16-ecofin-ansice-cybersecurity-agency-reform) launched in December 2022 has no adopted text, and a [tripartite audit and certification agreement](2026-02-06 ADETIC, ANSICE, and TECHSO-GROUP Join Forces to Protect Chad's Digital Infrastructure) covers the national data centre.
developments:
The strategy is known only from a single relayed sentence; no document, launch date or adoption record is held ([strategy](2026-03-16-ecofin-ansice-cybersecurity-agency-reform)).

The audit agreement was signed between the digital agency, the security agency and a private firm. A United States firm separately offered to audit and certify the same facility in May 2026 and no source connects the two mandates ([agreement](2026-02-06 ADETIC, ANSICE, and TECHSO-GROUP Join Forces to Protect Chad's Digital Infrastructure), [security](2026-02-06 Chad Moves to Secure National Data Center Ahead of Launch)).

A comparative study of online job scams published in August 2026 is the only measure of harm in this ledger; it surveys respondents rather than reporting a crime series, and carries no sample size or national total ([scams](2026-08-11-chad-cameroon-online-job-scams-cybercrime-report)).

summary: The 2027 budget orientations [provide for prohibiting ministry systems incompatible with existing platforms](2026-08-04-tchad-budget-2027-numerique-finances-publiques), and [accession to a regional digital integration programme](2026-06-02-salaminfo-banque-mondiale-routes-virtuelles-patn) is set for a second deployment phase.
developments:
The budget-framing text is not held and the ministry site was unreachable; the event date is unestablished, and no cost, phasing or implementing agency is named ([prohibition](2026-08-04-tchad-budget-2027-numerique-finances-publiques)).

Accession to the regional programme reaches the base as a single mention in a mission read-out ([accession](2026-06-02-salaminfo-banque-mondiale-routes-virtuelles-patn)).

Prohibiting incompatible systems presupposes a standard to be compatible with, and the digital code that would supply it has no adopted text.

summary: The [national biometric register](2026-03-16 Chad uses national biometric registry to boost govt systems interoperability) concluded a real-time data-sharing agreement with the finance ministry, on a claim of single source of truth that is the agency's own.
developments:
The register launched in 2020 on a French supplier's technology, and the single-source-of-truth claim is the agency's own and is not independently verified ([register](2026-03-16 Chad uses national biometric registry to boost govt systems interoperability), [refugees](2025-05-09-biometricupdate-refugees-biometric-ids-idemia-unhcr), [agreement](2026-05-07-anats-oim-mou-identite-securisee)).

Real-time sharing with the finance ministry, in a country with no data-protection statute and no supervisory authority, is a design decision nothing on record governs.

summary: A [child birth-registration campaign](2026-07-24-tchad-un-enfant-un-acte-de-naissance-enregistrer-un-million-denfants) opened a six-month first phase, backed by a [moratorium on court fees](2026-07-24-tchad-un-enfant-un-acte-de-naissance-enregistrer-un-million-denfants) for supplementary birth judgments until 2030.
developments:
The campaign runs a first phase of six months to December 2026; one account puts its household component in twelve provinces and another says every province ([campaign](2026-07-24-tchad-un-enfant-un-acte-de-naissance-enregistrer-un-million-denfants), [registration](2026-07-29-lepaystchad-gratuite-jugement-suppletif-etat-civil), [identity](2026-07-31-tchad-campagne-identite-des-enfants-enregistrement-etat-civil)).

The fee moratorium was signed in February 2026, suspending court fees for children aged four months to seventeen years until 2030; the instrument's own text is not held and its terms are known only from launch statements ([moratorium](2026-07-24-tchad-un-enfant-un-acte-de-naissance-enregistrer-un-million-denfants)).

Health-facility-integrated registration is reported by a practitioner, with stated plans to raise digitised hospital points from ninety-seven to six hundred and reach zero unregistered births by 2030 ([facilities](2025-06-03 Chad, Mali, Senegal pursue birth registration reforms to close gaps)), and a francophone civil-registration project has a second phase in preparation on the organisation's own claim ([project](2025-08-12 La Francophonie supports birth registration efforts across Central Africa, Madagascar)).

summary: A [mass enrolment and subscriber-data partnership](2026-05-09-tchadinfos-anats-airtel-partenariat-securisation-donnees) was signed with a mobile operator, wiring subscriber data into the identity register.
developments:
The partnership was signed in May 2026 ([partnership](2026-05-09-tchadinfos-anats-airtel-partenariat-securisation-donnees)).

It wires subscriber data into the identity register with no data-protection authority on file overseeing it. No enrolment target, retention rule, consent mechanism or regulator role is stated.

Together with the finance ministry's real-time feed, that gives the register two live interconnections and no supervision.

summary: The [exclusive electronic state-payment regime](2026-08-04-tchad-budget-2027-numerique-finances-publiques) slipped to a 1 January 2027 start, and [3,000 payment terminals](2026-07-24-lepaystchad-3000-terminaux-paiement-electronique-patn) were delivered with nothing showing one reaching a counter.
developments:
The regime was set out in the 2026 budget as zero cash and zero paper and has been restated for a 2027 start; the slip is the finding ([regime](2026-08-04-tchad-budget-2027-numerique-finances-publiques), [budget](2026-01-24-budget-2026-zero-cash-zero-papier-fen)).

Three thousand smart terminals were delivered to the finance ministry under the lender operation, and nothing on the record shows a terminal reaching a counter ([terminals](2026-07-24-lepaystchad-3000-terminaux-paiement-electronique-patn)).

A framework agreement on mobile payment of public services was worked on with four operators in February 2026 and nothing since shows it concluded ([framework](2026-02-17-journaldutchad-paiement-mobile-services-publics)).

summary: An [interoperable payments platform partnership](2026-04-02-wearetech-cashi-sfi-ifc-paiements-numeriques) was announced with an international finance institution.
developments:
The partnership was announced in April 2026 ([partnership](2026-04-02-wearetech-cashi-sfi-ifc-paiements-numeriques)).

No value, scope, timetable or participant list is published. It is the only business-facing payments instrument in this ledger, against three licensed wallets whose usage is unmeasured.

summary: A [second mobile-money operator obtained a payment-institution licence](2026-07-29-leconomie-tchad-moov-money-etablissement-paiement-agree), joining one [licensed in 2023](2026-07-29-leconomie-tchad-moov-money-etablissement-paiement-agree) and a [multichannel wallet licensed in 2025](2026-06-19-wearetech-konoom-paiements-numeriques-multicanal).
developments:
The second operator's approval is dated April 2026 on its own filing and July 2026 in the trade press — two dates for one licence ([licence](2026-07-29-leconomie-tchad-moov-money-etablissement-paiement-agree), [filing](2026-07-22-maroc-telecom-rapport-financier-semestriel-2026)).

The first operator was licensed as a payment institution in 2023 at year precision, and its launch date is not established ([first](2026-07-29-leconomie-tchad-moov-money-etablissement-paiement-agree), [launch](2024-05-06 Airtel launches mobile money transfers in Chad)). A multichannel wallet is in service, licensed in 2025, with no user, agent-network or transaction figure published ([wallet](2026-06-19-wearetech-konoom-paiements-numeriques-multicanal)).

Mobile-money transaction value is held from a central bank measurement for end-2024 ([value](2026-07-29-leconomie-tchad-moov-money-etablissement-paiement-agree)), which is the only quantity in the payments record and is nearly two years old.

summary: The regional central bank [acceded to the continental payment and settlement system](2026-07-10-beac-joins-papss-cemac-banks-agenceecofin) with member-state banks to connect by end-2026, and a [regional interoperable switch](2026-07-30-cemac-gimacpay-transactions-2025) published 2025 figures.
developments:
Accession was announced in July 2026; no Chadian bank is named and the end-2026 target is untested ([accession](2026-07-10-beac-joins-papss-cemac-banks-agenceecofin)).

The regional switch presented annual figures for 2025 at a regional meeting, and no country-disaggregated figure for it exists in this base ([switch](2026-07-30-cemac-gimacpay-transactions-2025), [merchant](2026-08-01-leconomie-paiement-marchand-interoperable-cemac-premier-trimestre-2026)).

A regional interoperable code standard launched under a monetary union regulation of April 2026; no domestic bank, wallet or merchant deployment is on record, so the country is covered by the regulation rather than shown live ([standard](2026-07-30-cemac-gimac-norme-qr-code-interoperable)).

summary: [Digital civil registration](2025-09-17-anats-etat-civil-numerique-lancement) was launched with message transfer from registry offices, hospitals, camps and mobile units to the identity agency for validation.
developments:
The architecture is reported as message transfer from registry offices, hospitals, camps and mobile units to the identity agency for validation ([registration](2025-09-17-anats-etat-civil-numerique-lancement), [interoperability](2026-04-28-tribuneechos-anats-oif-etat-civil-interoperabilite)).

A civil-registration application is dated to 2021 by an international official, at year precision from a single sentence, and no source connects it to the programme launched in September 2025 ([application](2026-08-08-sarh-un-atelier-pour-renforcer-la-collecte-et-la-transmission-des-donnees-detat-civil)).

Birth registration within the legal deadline is reported from ministry data for 2024, and three accounts round the undeclared total to 2.948m, 2.95m and 2.958m — three figures for one number ([deadline](2026-07-31-tchad-campagne-identite-des-enfants-enregistrement-etat-civil)).

summary: [Electronic medical records and health-facility interconnection](2026-07-01 Chad and US Explore Partnerships on Satellite Connectivity and Cybersecurity) reached exploratory meetings, a [solar-kiosk telemedicine service](2025-02-11-telemedan-solar-kiosks-rural-healthcare) reports cumulative usage, and a [regional surveillance operation closed](2025-11-30-worldbank-icr-redisse-iv-health-surveillance).
developments:
The exploratory meetings took place on a mission of late May 2026 ([meetings](2026-07-01 Chad and US Explore Partnerships on Satellite Connectivity and Cybersecurity), [mission](2026-06-01-digitalbusiness-washington-partenariats-tech)).

The telemedicine service's user and consultation figures are company-reported by the founder, and a plan of 100 kiosks reaching a million people over three years has no progress record ([telemedicine](2025-02-11-telemedan-solar-kiosks-rural-healthcare)).

An exploratory meeting and a founder's own figures are the whole of the health digitisation record for this country.

2025-11-30 - the World Bank's implementation completion report [closed REDISSE Phase IV, a US$280m five-country regional disease-surveillance operation carrying a health information and ICT subcomponent at 14% of the sector share and naming DHIS2, IDSR and EWARS among its systems](2025-11-30-worldbank-icr-redisse-iv-health-surveillance). The held capture is an excerpt: it states no country-specific system, coverage or outcome, so what the operation left behind here is not on the record.

summary: Ministry statistics and digitalisation staff were [trained on an education management information system](2026-07-30-le-mesrsfp-renforce-les-capacites-de-ses-agents-sur-lapplication-stateduc), at the higher-education ministry only.
developments:
The training ran over six days in July 2026 ([training](2026-07-30-le-mesrsfp-renforce-les-capacites-de-ses-agents-sur-lapplication-stateduc)).

The system sits under a school-reform programme financed by an international education partnership and implemented with agency support, and it is reported by that agency rather than by the ministry. It covers the higher-education ministry only, so basic and secondary education have no management information system in this record.

summary: A [standardised electronic invoice](2026-01-24-budget-2026-zero-cash-zero-papier-fen) is mandatory from the 2026 budget with exclusive use deferred to 2027, and a [revenue-administration digitalisation project](2018-07-06-wb-tcd-002-chad-digitalization-of-revenue-administrations-and) closed in 2023.
developments:
The invoice is mandatory from the 2026 budget, with exclusive use as the basis for state payment starting in 2027; no count of invoices issued, taxpayers enrolled or systems connected is published ([invoice](2026-01-24-budget-2026-zero-cash-zero-papier-fen), [orientations](2026-08-04-tchad-budget-2027-numerique-finances-publiques)).

The revenue-administration digitalisation project closed in 2023 at year precision, and its instrument label is the capture's own default and unverified ([project](2018-07-06-wb-tcd-002-chad-digitalization-of-revenue-administrations-and)).

A closed project, a mandatory invoice with no enrolment count and a deferred exclusivity date are the whole of the revenue digitisation record.

summary: A [freight bureau enrolment platform](2026-08-04-tchad-plateforme-numerique-e-bnft-fret-terrestre) was presented abroad, and a [CEMAC mission assessed transit interoperability](2026-04-22-caf-guardianpost-cemac-transit-sigmat-sydonia) with Cameroon's customs platform.
developments:
The presentation was made in August 2026 ([platform](2026-08-04-tchad-plateforme-numerique-e-bnft-fret-terrestre)).

Nothing on file relates it to the transport ministry's own planned platform. For a landlocked country whose freight moves through that port, a platform launched abroad and unconnected to the domestic transport programme is worth recording as the arrangement it is.

2026-04-22 - a Cameroon Customs mission supported by AFRITAC Centre [assessed interoperability between Cameroon's CAMCIS and the SYDONIA World platform Chad and the Central African Republic use, and prepared implementation of the CEMAC regional SIGMAT transit-tracking system](2026-04-22-caf-guardianpost-cemac-transit-sigmat-sydonia), with fieldwork of 21 to 30 April 2026; no implementation date, cost or interface specification is published.

summary: The 2027 budget orientations provide for an [electronic visa as the sole channel](2026-08-04-tchad-budget-2027-numerique-finances-publiques) and [fully online business creation](2026-08-04-tchad-budget-2027-numerique-finances-publiques), and a [sovereign data platform](2026-08-07-chad-guidam-platform-biennial-report-accountability) produced a biennial delivery report.
developments:
The base holds no statement on whether an electronic visa operates today, and exclusivity is stated with no fallback channel ([visa](2026-08-04-tchad-budget-2027-numerique-finances-publiques)). Fully online business creation is provided for from 2027, with a continental bank programme separately funding interconnection of business one-stop shops ([business](2026-08-04-tchad-budget-2027-numerique-finances-publiques), [programme](2026-07-09-iati-46002-p-td-k00-019-chad-public-administration-modernization)).

A biennial delivery report on the presidential programme was produced through a sovereign data platform; no custodian, supplier, hosting arrangement or public access to the platform or its data is stated, and the report itself is not held ([platform](2026-08-07-chad-guidam-platform-biennial-report-accountability)).

An integrated transport-services platform was discussed at a ministerial meeting in September 2025 with nothing further on file, its stated scope covering vehicle registration, driving licences, technical inspection, transport licences and permits ([transport](2025-09-12 Chad to deploy integrated digital platform for transport services)).

summary: A working session addressed [interoperability between the biometric system and communal registers](2026-04-28-tribuneechos-anats-oif-etat-civil-interoperabilite) in the capital municipality.
developments:
The session took place in April 2026 ([session](2026-04-28-tribuneechos-anats-oif-etat-civil-interoperabilite), [support](2025-08-12 La Francophonie supports birth registration efforts across Central Africa, Madagascar)).

It is the only local-government item the base holds for this country. No outcome, connected-register count or timetable is published.

summary: [Privatisation of the state telecommunications operator](2026-02-16 Waking the dead - Slow road to extinction for Africa's former telco incumbents 11) was re-announced with a 60 per cent stake offered and no advisory bank appointed.
developments:
The re-announcement was made in February 2025; staff were cut from about 10,000 to under 500 after a sale and subsequent nationalisation, and the account is a named analyst's ([privatisation](2026-02-16 Waking the dead - Slow road to extinction for Africa's former telco incumbents 11), [strategy](2025-07-18-techafricanews-tchad-connexion-2030-strategy-1-5b)).

No advisory bank has been appointed and no process is on record. A state operator reduced by that much, offered for sale with no adviser, is the industrial capacity this country has.

summary: A [two-day session for 120 young people](2026-03-26-pdmfi-120-jeunes-outils-numeriques-inclusion-financiere) on digital tools and financial inclusion, and a [youth digital innovation and employment programme](2026-04-17-d-clic-makers-tchad-jeunes-innovateurs) launched at a maker space.
developments:
The two-day session was a single cohort rather than a standing programme, delivered under a continental bank microfinance grant ([session](2026-03-26-pdmfi-120-jeunes-outils-numeriques-inclusion-financiere)).

The innovation and employment programme was launched with the national employment office and a francophone body in April 2026, and no budget figure is stated ([programme](2026-04-17-d-clic-makers-tchad-jeunes-innovateurs)).

Two cohorts and a launch are the entire training record for a country of this size, against a national connectivity strategy whose planned investment is recorded elsewhere in this report.

summary: A [memorandum on secure identity for vulnerable populations](2026-05-07-anats-oim-mou-identite-securisee) was signed with a migration organisation, and [more than 4,000 refugee identity numbers](2026-03-16 Chad uses national biometric registry to boost govt systems interoperability) have been issued in a pilot.
developments:
The memorandum was signed in May 2026 ([memorandum](2026-05-07-anats-oim-mou-identite-securisee)).

The refugee pilot is lender-funded with the refugee agency and the national refugee commission, on a French supplier's technology ([pilot](2026-03-16 Chad uses national biometric registry to boost govt systems interoperability), [identities](2025-05-09-biometricupdate-refugees-biometric-ids-idemia-unhcr)).

A refugee digital learning centre was inaugurated at a one-stop shop in the east with Italian funding, and no cohort numbers are held at either end ([centre](2025-02-25-centre-apprentissage-numerique-abeche)). Biometric enrolment of displaced people, again with no protection statute behind it, is the largest inclusion activity in this ledger.

summary: A decree [extended the main census enumeration](2026-07-20-lepaystchad-rgph3-prorogation-denombrement) to 6 August 2026, and days from the close one nomadic district had still not seen an enumerator.
developments:
The extension decree was issued on 20 July 2026 ([extension](2026-07-20-lepaystchad-rgph3-prorogation-denombrement)).

Neither census decree is held: the country has no reachable online gazette and the statistics institute's site has no address record. Days from the close, one nomadic district had still not seen an enumerator ([nomads](2026-07-30-lendjampost-rgph3-batha-populations-nomades)).

A statistical development project closed in 2022 at year precision, on the same unverified instrument label as the revenue project ([project](2017-04-03-wb-tcd-003-chad-statistical-development-project)).

summary: A [space cooperation protocol](2026-01-29-tchad24-azercosmos-accord-spatial) was signed with a national space agency at the capital.
developments:
The protocol was signed in early 2026 ([protocol](2026-01-29-tchad24-azercosmos-accord-spatial), [cooperation](2026-02-19-techafricanews-chad-azerbaijan-adetic-ict)).

It is the only earth-observation item the base holds for this country. No data source, application, value or timetable is stated.

summary: A [United States digital work programme](2026-07-01 Chad and US Explore Partnerships on Satellite Connectivity and Cybersecurity) reached a mission and a readiness to support with nothing signed, and the minister flagged visa refusals for technical personnel as a delivery risk.
developments:
A mission was held in May 2026 and readiness to support was conveyed at the end of June, with nothing signed; the two accounts give different mission dates ([programme](2026-07-01 Chad and US Explore Partnerships on Satellite Connectivity and Cybersecurity), [partnerships](2026-06-01-digitalbusiness-washington-partenariats-tech), [cooperation](2025-12-02 Chad Accelerates Digital Cooperation to Support Its Transformation Agenda)).

The minister flagged United States visa refusals for Chadian technical personnel as a delivery risk, which is a rare instance of a government naming the counterparty's own policy as the obstacle to a partnership with it.

Cybersecurity cooperation with the United States infrastructure security agency reached a videoconference after attendance at a Washington summit, with no instrument on file ([cyber](2025-01-25-ansice-cisa-cybersecurite-infrastructures-critiques)).

summary: [Two Chinese grant agreements](2026-08-21-horonyafinance-tchad-chine-don-infrastructures-numerique) were signed in August 2026 with no project list or digital allocation published, and a [Chinese vendor is contractor](2025-12-29 Chad Steps Up Rollout of Tchad Connexion 2030 in Talks With Huawei) for the national data centre and the backbone.
developments:
The grant agreements were signed on 20 August 2026; the local-currency equivalents in circulation differ between outlets on their own conversion dates, and no project list or digital allocation is published ([grants](2026-08-21-horonyafinance-tchad-chine-don-infrastructures-numerique), [agreements](2026-08-20-ecomatin-tchad-chine-don-300-millions-yuans), [financing](2026-08-20-tchadinfos-bad-chine-accords-financement-modernisation)).

The vendor has been contractor for the national data centre and the backbone with a supervising engineer, and December 2025 coverage frames it as a prospective partner when it had been the incumbent contractor for five years ([contractor](2025-12-29 Chad Steps Up Rollout of Tchad Connexion 2030 in Talks With Huawei), [finalisation](2025-01-10-agenceecofin-tchad-centre-donnees-national-finalisation)).

Technology and artificial-intelligence scholarships were announced at a ministerial audience with no value, selection route, timetable or host institution stated ([scholarships](2026-08-17-camerpressagency-tchad-chine-ambition-numerique)), and a fifth-generation platform request to the same supplier has no decision, funding or delivery on record ([request](2026-02-16 Waking the dead - Slow road to extinction for Africa's former telco incumbents 11)).

summary: An [Indian digital partnership](2025-12-02 Chad Accelerates Digital Cooperation to Support Its Transformation Agenda) reached a ministerial meeting at which a memorandum was intended and no timeline was announced.
developments:
The scope asked for was training of Chadian engineers in artificial intelligence, support to the national information technology school, and digitalisation of postal services including a postal bank ([partnership](2025-12-02 Chad Accelerates Digital Cooperation to Support Its Transformation Agenda), [meeting](2025-02-17-tchad-inde-partenariat-numerique)).

No memorandum was signed and no timeline was announced. What the country asked for is on the record and what it received is not.
